title: Small Business Marketing: The Ultimate Guide | Salesforce CA

facts.fact: After Google Analytics tracking is set up correctly, the guide says it should take 24 to 48 hours to see data in the account.
facts.quote: it should take 24 to 48 hours to see data in your Google Analytics account.

facts.fact: The guide says Google Analytics is free to use.
The guide advises scheduling content between one and six months ahead, leaving room for delays or postponements.
facts.quote: Aim between one and six months ahead, leaving wiggle room for when content is delayed or postponed.

facts.fact: A SISTRIX study cited by Salesforce finds that the first organic search result earns approximately 29% of users' clicks.
facts.quote: A [study from SISTRIX](https://www.sistrix.com/blog/why-almost-everything-you-knew-about-google-ctr-is-no-longer-valid/#285-of-Google-users-click-the-first-organic-result) shows that ranking first on the first page of search results earns approximately 29% of users’ clicks.

facts.fact: The SISTRIX study cited by Salesforce finds that the second organic search result earns 16% of clicks.
facts.quote: The second result gets 16%, the third earns 11%, and the percentages drop rapidly from there.

facts.fact: Salesforce suggests a small business start its content with a starting point of four or five blog posts.
facts.quote: For instance, four or five blog posts is a good starting point.

facts.fact: Salesforce states that e-books should be 2,000-plus words as a good goal, though there is no hard rule.
facts.quote: There’s no hard rule, but 2,000-plus words is a good goal because e-books provide more in-depth content

facts.fact: Salesforce advises that a hosting package can typically be purchased for a year or longer upfront.
facts.quote: You can typically purchase a year or longer upfront, and choose to elect upgrades such as a business email address using your domain name, website themes, and more.

facts.fact: Google My Business is described by Salesforce as a free tool for managing a business's online presence on Google.
facts.quote: This free tool allows businesses to manage their online presence on Google.

facts.fact: Salesforce states that in both B2C and B2B companies, advertising is the top marketing budget line item, with technology a close second.
facts.quote: is the top marketing budget line item, while technology is a close second.

facts.fact: Salesforce describes micro-influencers as influencers with even a few thousand followers who can promote a business in exchange for payment, a free product, or a cut of sales.
facts.quote: Influencers with even a few thousand followers (micro-influencers)

facts.fact: Salesforce notes that business associations typically charge dues, and members are sometimes entitled to discounts on continuing education or business insurance.
facts.quote: There are typically dues, and members are sometimes entitled to discounts on things like continued education or business insurance.

facts.fact: Salesforce describes SEO as a good free or low-cost pathway for promoting a small business without spending money.
facts.quote: SEO is a good free or low-cost pathway.

facts.fact: Google My Business lets a business list its location and hours, add photos, and respond to user reviews.
facts.quote: You can list your location and hours, add photos, respond to user reviews, and more

facts.fact: A survey of 1,000 adults, cited by the page with a link to McKinsey, found that 80% want retailers to personalize their shopping experience.
facts.quote: A survey of 1,000 adults revealed that [80% want retailers to personalize their shopping experience](https://www.mckinsey.com/industries/retail/our-insights/personalizing-the-customer-experience-driving-differentiation-in-retail)
